product.olivetti-m6-400.summary: The M6 marketed by Olivetti as the PC Green.
product.olivetti-m6-400.history: In April 1994, ASCII reported its Japanese offer at ¥236.000 with 170 MB and ¥271.000 with 340 MB.
product.olivetti-m6-400.architecture: One module expands the memory. The board has 4 MB soldered down and accepts a SIMM of up to 32 MB.
product.olivetti-m6-400.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-400.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-400.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 7
product.olivetti-m6-400.ascii-1994: ASCII EXPRESS, April 1994, Japanese market report (archival reproduction)
product.olivetti-m6-400.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.06.
